description: Verify that Type 2 entry Length is 16 bytes (SubscribeAck/Nack)
approach:
[Objective]
Spec invariant for the SubscribeAck/Nack: Type 2 entry Length == 16 bytes.

[Scenario — chronological]
Tester drives DUT to emit a SubscribeAck/Nack (typically by sending a Subscribe).
Observation: captured Type 2 entry Length matches expected.   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Type 2 entry Length == 16 bytes.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a qualifying SubscribeAck/Nack within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: Type 2 entry Length matches expected — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SubscribeAck/Nack within listen window
